title: Andrographolide inhibits hepatocellular carcinoma progression and programmed death ligand-1 expression by blocking STAT3 phosphorylation.
authors: Fu, Hairong; Yuan, Yunchuan; Tan, Jiahua; Pang, Yi; Long, Yun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究穿心莲内酯通过抑制STAT3磷酸化下调PD-L1表达以治疗肝癌，虽涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白作用及肿瘤免疫，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is an aggressive malignancy with frequent recurrence and strong immune evasion. Programmed death ligand-1 (PD-L1) facilitates immune evasion by suppressing T-cell activity. Andrographolide (AD), a natural diterpenoid with anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and immunomodulatory properties, has demonstrated antitumor potential. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Subcutaneous HCC mouse models assessed the antitumor and immune-activating effects of AD. CCK-8 assay, colony-formation assay, apoptosis analyses, and western blot investigated AD's impacts on Huh-7 cell proliferation, apoptosis, and cell cycle. Immunofluorescence staining and flow cytometry collectively measured PD-L1 expression after AD treatment. Molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay detected the targeted binding between AD and STAT3. Finally, recombinant interleukin-6 (rIL-6), a STAT3 activator, was used to verify whether AD-mediated effects on Huh-7 cell viability and PD-L1 expression were STAT3-dependent. RESULTS: In vivo, AD significantly inhibited mouse tumor growth, decreased PD-L1 expression in tumor tissues, and enhanced T-cell infiltration. In vitro, through cell experiments, AD bound to STAT3 and inhibited tumor cell proliferation, induced apoptosis, and downregulated PD-L1 protein levels by suppressing the phosphorylation of STAT3. Treatment with rIL-6 significantly reversed AD's antitumor effects. CONCLUSION: AD inhibits HCC progression and PD-L1 expression by blocking STAT3 phosphorylation, providing a theoretical foundation for developing AD-based therapeutic strategies against HCC.
abstract_zh: 背景：肝细胞癌（HCC）是一种侵袭性恶性肿瘤，具有高复发率和强免疫逃逸能力。程序性死亡配体1（PD-L1）通过抑制T细胞活性促进免疫逃逸。穿心莲内酯（AD）是一种天然二萜类化合物，具有抗炎、抗病毒和免疫调节特性，并显示出抗肿瘤潜力。材料与方法：采用皮下HCC小鼠模型评估AD的抗肿瘤和免疫激活效应。通过CCK-8实验、集落形成实验、凋亡分析和蛋白质印迹法研究AD对Huh-7细胞增殖、凋亡和细胞周期的影响。免疫荧光染色和流式细胞术共同检测AD处理后PD-L1的表达。分子对接和细胞热位移实验检测AD与STAT3之间的靶向结合。最后，使用重组白细胞介素-6（rIL-6）（一种STAT3激活剂）验证AD对Huh-7细胞活力和PD-L1表达的影响是否依赖于STAT3。结果：在体内，AD显著抑制小鼠肿瘤生长，降低肿瘤组织中PD-L1表达，并增强T细胞浸润。在体外，通过细胞实验，AD与STAT3结合，抑制肿瘤细胞增殖，诱导凋亡，并通过抑制STAT3磷酸化下调PD-L1蛋白水平。rIL-6处理显著逆转了AD的抗肿瘤效应。结论：AD通过阻断STAT3磷酸化抑制HCC进展和PD-L1表达，为开发基于AD的抗HCC治疗策略提供了理论基础。
